description: Lightweight random-walk MCMC with independent chains and scalar or per-chain proposal scales. Independent chains use the async multi-chain pipeline: shared hep:task_queue, per-chain hep:feedback:chain:{id}, one in-flight evaluation per chain (see Jarvis man sampler.mcmc-runtime).
x-jarvis-example:
Method: ToyMCMC
Bounds:
  num_chains: 4
  num_iters: 2000
  proposal_scale: 0.2
  seed: 0
Variables:
  - name: x
    distribution:
      type: Flat
      parameters: {min: 0.0, max: 1.0}

Bounds.description: ToyMCMC settings shared by all chains except proposal_scale, which may be per-chain. Prefer num_chains >= Runtime workers so the async pipeline can fill the worker pool.

num_chains.description: Number of independent chains (async 1-inflight each; prefer >= workers).

proposal_scale.description: One positive proposal scale for every chain; a scalar or one-element list broadcasts, while a list with one value per chain supplies per-chain scales.
